name: @bowerloom/tauri-stage1-spike
description: Stage 1 of the Tauri move, macOS phase: Gate 1 Part C and the payload baseline. A spike. Nothing here ships.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-concurrency=1 test/part-c.test.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && ../../apps/desktop/node_modules/.bin/electron-builder --projectDir app --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.build:tauri: node build.mjs --tauri && node scripts/prepare-tauri.mjs && node scripts/tauri-build.mjs
scripts.test:tauri: node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-concurrency=1 test/sidecar-core.test.mjs test/part-a.test.mjs test/part-b.test.mjs test/gate2.test.mjs test/no-e2e-in-release.test.mjs
